motion.name: reveal-standard
motion.purpose: Default FadeInItem and RevealItem entrance duration; reduced motion uses a 150ms fade without delay or translation. WelcomeSection overrides durations to 550–600ms with no entrance delays below 900px.

motion.name: interactive-dot-pulse
motion.purpose: InteractiveHoverButton resting dot pulse; disabled during interaction and for reduced motion.

motion.name: interactive-dot-fill
motion.purpose: InteractiveHoverButton expanding dot; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: project-scale-entrance
motion.purpose: WelcomeSection project previews scale from 0.96 to 1 after image load and viewport visibility. Reduced motion removes scale and uses a 150ms fade without delay.

motion.name: project-float
motion.purpose: Only Actio and Zeynep Dikdüş float on desktop. Pause offscreen and in hidden tabs; disable below 900px and for reduced motion.

motion.name: welcome-cta-entrance
motion.purpose: Both hero CTAs reveal together. Mobile entrance delay is zero; reduced motion removes translation and uses a 150ms fade without delay.

motion.name: footer-artwork-scroll
motion.purpose: Footer uses fixed 5% horizontal and 36px vertical padding. Only decorative artwork scales from full width to its inset frame; text and layout remain stable. Reduced motion fixes scaleX at 1. The heading reuses FadeInItem with a 500ms normal delay and a delay-free 150ms reduced-motion fade.

motion.name: global-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: src/app/global.css switches smooth scrolling to auto and disables .scale-on-hover transitions and enlargement. Navbar home navigation uses behavior: auto so global CSS controls scrolling.

responsive.services: ServicesSection has no fixed mobile height and a 750px desktop minimum. ServicesCard grows with text; padding is 16px below 600px and 32px above. Image minimum height: 220px at xs, 240px at sm, 180px at md.
responsive.projectCard: MyWorkCard uses full width, wrapping text and media height clamp(220px, 40vw, 400px). Props: title, description, images, href, animationDirection (left/right).
responsive.singleImageRow: SingleImageRow media height: clamp(220px, 56vw, 640px). Props: imageUrl, alt, containerStyle (sx override). Opens the existing fullscreen modal.
responsive.multipleImageRow: MultipleImageRow stacks below 600px with individual height clamp(220px, 75vw, 400px). Above 600px it shares a row of height clamp(280px, 45vw, 640px). Props: images, containerStyle (sx override). Opens the existing fullscreen modal.
responsive.welcome: Hero CTAs span available width below 600px, wrap above with a 150px minimum, and have a 40px minimum height with multiline labels. IhrHaus preview max-width: 100%.
responsive.contact: ContactHeader text uses width: 100%, min-width: 0 and overflow-wrap: anywhere. Path: src/components/ContactSection/ContactHeader/index.tsx. Prop: scrollYProgress (MotionValue<number>). Usage: <ContactHeader scrollYProgress={scrollYProgress} />. A module-level motion.create(Stack) wrapper accepts the opacity and vertical MotionValues directly, without type assertions. ContactForm email also uses overflow-wrap: anywhere.

imageLoading.sizes: Active portfolio fill images use container-specific sizes: service columns, portrait capped at 400px, cards and gallery rows divided by image count, modal capped at 900px, footer 100vw.
imageLoading.serviceProps: ServicesCard adds optional sizes; default matches the wider desktop column and ServicesSection overrides it for the narrower design column.
imageLoading.quality: Default 75 for service artwork, portrait, previews, cards and modal; gallery quality 50 is explicitly allowed alongside 75 in next.config.mjs. Source assets are preserved.
imageLoading.heroPreload: Only FitNLit is preloaded, with media (min-width: 900px); getImageProps shares its srcset/sizes with the actual image props. Mobile collage and other portfolio imagery use lazy loading.
imageLoading.modal: src/components/FullScreenImageModal/index.tsx: props isOpen, onClose, imageUrl?, alt?. Usage: <FullScreenImageModal isOpen={open} onClose={close} imageUrl={url} alt={alt} />. sizes: (min-width: 964px) 900px, calc(100vw - 64px); default quality 75.

composition.services: src/components/ServicesSection/index.tsx and ServicesCard render on the server; ServicesSection has no props, usage <ServicesSection /> and getTranslations for localized copy.
composition.biography: src/components/WhoAmISection/index.tsx is a server component with no props, usage <WhoAmISection />. Existing FadeInItem, RevealItem and DotPattern retain client-side motion.
composition.projects: src/components/MyWorksSection/index.tsx and src/app/[locale]/projects/page.tsx select locale and full project data on the server. MyWorksSection takes no props, usage <MyWorksSection />. Cards receive serializable title, description, images, href and optional animationDirection.
composition.boundaries: MyWorkCard, FadeInItem and RevealItem explicitly declare use client. MyWorkCard requires href instead of the former onClick navigation callback, using the existing locale-aware Link. Entrance timing and reduced-motion behavior stay unchanged.

semanticColors.source: Named semanticColors export in src/utils/colors.ts; default colors export retained for compatibility.
semanticColors.theme: src/utils/theme.ts maps actions, text, backgrounds and divider to MUI. CssBaseline renders inside ThemeProvider. Light only; dark mode and automatic system-theme switching are outside scope.
semanticColors.focus: MuiButtonBase supplies a 3px focusRing outline with 3px offset for Mui-focusVisible. Fields use the same token; InteractiveHoverButton retains its component-specific brick focus outline.
semanticColors.migration: ServicesCard and gallery backgrounds use surface; ChipRow uses surface/textMuted. ContactForm uses semantic backgrounds, text, icon surfaces, border and focusRing with MUI error.main for invalid fields. MyWorkCard uses the theme Divider instead of a translucent white override. Project detail white background uses the central palette.

componentContracts.ChipRow: src/components/ProjectDetails/ChipRow/index.tsx: labels string[], optional containerProps StackProps and chipProps ChipProps. Usage: <ChipRow labels={["React", "Next.js"]} />.
componentContracts.ContactForm: src/components/ContactSection/ContactForm/index.tsx: no configuration props; optional forwarded ref identifies the section for parent scroll behavior. Usage: <ContactForm ref={targetRef} />. Existing validation/submission behavior is retained.

localization.messages: src/locales/tr.json and en.json have matching keys and interpolation variables. project_details.visit_project is resolved on the server with the route locale.
localization.previews: src/components/WelcomeSection/ProjectsOverview/index.tsx: client component, no props, usage <ProjectsOverview />. Uses welcome_section fitnlit_alt, actio_alt, ihrhaus_alt and zeynep_alt for actual images; the resource-only preload shares sizing props.
localization.projectImages: Existing locale-specific src/data/projects.tr.ts and projects.en.ts store screen-specific alt descriptions, passed unchanged through cards, gallery rows and modals.
localization.modal: FullScreenImageModal preserves supplied alt, including empty string; absent alt falls back to accessibility.project_image. Close label uses accessibility.close_image.
localization.navigation: src/components/Navbar/index.tsx: no props; usage <Navbar />. Home controls use navbar.home and redundant logo alts are empty. Contact social icons are decorative because adjacent localized text names the action. Brand names remain unchanged.

components.name: Accent CTA

components.name: Submit CTA
components.description: High-confidence form action with AA text contrast.

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Softly rounded contact input with an explicit focus ring.

components.name: Project Card
components.description: src/components/MyWorkCard/index.tsx: full-width image-led project action with wrapping text. Props: title, description, images (url/alt), href, optional animationDirection (left/right). Usage: <MyWorkCard title={title} description={summary} images={images} href="/projects/fitnlit" />. Explicit client component for animation; locale-aware Link resolves the project href. Static layouts and full project data stay on the server.
components.css: .ds-project-card { width:100%; min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; color:#111827; font-family:Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-project-media { height:clamp(220px,40vw,400px); background:#F0F3F6; border-radius:16px; } .ds-project-card h3 { margin:16px 16px 8px; font-size:24px; line-height:1.3; } .ds-project-card p { margin:0 16px 16px; color:#5E6673; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Quiet, compact navigation that leaves visual priority to portfolio work.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; align-items:center; font:400 16px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:1.3px; } .ds-nav a { color:#111827; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#173B6C; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #173B6C; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Interactive Hover Button
components.description: src/components/InteractiveHoverButton/index.tsx: shadow-free CTA with an expanding brick dot. Props: children, icon, pulse (default true), and standard MUI Button props. Navbar usage supplies a downward arrow; duplicate label and icon are hidden from assistive technology.

components.name: Footer
components.description: src/components/Footer/index.tsx (default import @/components/Footer): localized closing statement and copyright over decorative artwork. No props; usage: <Footer />. Fixed 5% horizontal and 36px vertical padding, 16px artwork corners, and stable text. Only artwork scales horizontally on scroll; reduced motion keeps its final scale. Heading reuses FadeInItem.

narrative.overview:
The interface is a clean, contemporary, light-first portfolio that earns attention through project imagery, generous whitespace, clear typography, and restrained motion. It should feel modern and technically capable without resembling a generic software dashboard or relying on visual hype.

The geometric POLAT logo establishes a navy-and-brick identity. Deep navy gives the interface authority and makes primary actions feel deliberate; brick adds entrepreneurial energy in restrained signals. White remains dominant so the work stays central and the identity feels established rather than loud.
keyCharacteristics: Spacious, image-led compositions with strong text hierarchy.
Authority navy for actions and emphasis, with restrained brick signals against white.
Softly rounded project surfaces with subtle, low-contrast depth.
Purposeful reveal and scroll motion that never competes with the work.

rules.name: The Navy Leads Rule
rules.body: Navy owns actions, links, focus, and primary emphasis. Brick is a controlled signal for the logo and selected highlights; it never competes with navy as a second primary CTA color.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use white on navy and brick. Supporting Slate is only used on white or equivalently light surfaces; Authority Ink carries primary text.

rules.name: Flat by default
rules.body: Use shadow only to clarify layering, interaction, or a featured composition.

rules.name: No button shadows
rules.body: Buttons, including CTAs, navigation buttons, and icon buttons, must remain shadow-free in default, hover, pressed, focused, and disabled states. Do not use colored halos or elevation to attract attention to an action. Use color, contrast, borders, and spacing; retain visible focus outlines. This user preference also applies to future components and overrides generic button-elevation examples.

dos: **Do** let project imagery and shipped work provide the visual proof.
**Do** let Authority Navy lead actions, links, and focus.
**Do** use Entrepreneurial Brick sparingly for recognition and selected signals.
**Do** preserve generous whitespace and clear bilingual hierarchy.
**Do** keep motion smooth, controlled, and supportive of reading order.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, colored glows, or hover elevation to buttons or CTAs.
**Don't** turn brick into a competing primary action color or use it decoratively everywhere.
**Don't** fabricate testimonials, results, client claims, or project metrics.
**Don't** introduce gratuitous gradients, neon effects, or generic technology-dashboard styling.
**Don't** make every surface a card or use shadow as decoration.
**Don't** let interactive or 3D elements compete with the portfolio and contact journey.
